verdicts.reason: A shrinks the 'Find a Store' CTA to a tiny pill jammed near the bottom edge, so the call to action is buried. It also moves the olive circle to a cramped top-left corner, away from where the original had it, and leaves a dead gap between the bag and the headline. B keeps the CTA at full size right under the headline, keeps the original corner placement of the circles, and groups the bag, headline and CTA well. Both break the headline with 'fizz' orphaned on its own line, and B's olive circle crowds the bottom of the canvas a little.
